time_var.var_name: months to death or last fu

notes: GSM sample metadata explicitly provides both 'months to death or last fu' and 'status (alive - 0; dead/hospice - 1)' for all 17 samples.
The paper describes Kaplan-Meier and Cox survival analyses and refers to improved 'survival' without naming another endpoint; these metadata fields are most consistent with overall survival.
Time unit was inferred from the field name containing 'months'.
The time variable appears to mix death time and censored last follow-up time, as stated in the field name 'months to death or last fu'.
